title: A creator used AI to make a detective episode that looks retro
title_candidates: Everything in this detective show, including the actors, is AI-generated
One creator made a full detective TV episode with zero actors or cameras
How an AI-generated police procedural actually looks from start to finish
The detective show where every face, voice, and scene was made by AI
An entire TV episode written, cast, and filmed by AI alone
caption:
Someone built an entire detective TV show using AI, and every actor, voice, and scene in it was generated by a machine.

This is Dick Snifford, a fully AI-generated police procedural series. No actors, no cameras, no studio. Every frame came from an AI video model. One creator on Instagram made the whole thing.

A year ago this would have cost millions and needed a full production crew. Now it takes a laptop and an idea.
